meta.name: etetoolkit
meta.description: Phylogenetic tree toolkit (ETE). Tree manipulation (Newick/NHX), evolutionary event detection, orthology/paralogy, NCBI taxonomy, visualization (PDF/SVG), for phylogenomics.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析进化树并检测演化事件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果做系统发育基因组学或进化生物学研究
copy.tagline_en: Analyze phylogenetic trees and detect evolutionary events
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work in phylogenomics or evolutionary biology

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以操作进化树：读取、修改、比较树结构，检测基因复制/分化事件，整合NCBI物种分类，并生成PDF/SVG格式的树图。
howto.when: 当你要求分析进化树、检测直系同源基因、或可视化树结构时触发。

say.text: 帮我用这个Newick文件画一棵进化树，输出PDF。
say.note: Claude会读取文件并生成树图。

say.text: 分析这棵基因树中的复制和分化事件。
say.note: Claude会检测进化事件并输出结果。

say.text: 比较这两棵树的拓扑差异，计算RF距离。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can manipulate phylogenetic trees: read, modify, compare tree structures, detect gene duplication/speciation events, integrate NCBI taxonomy, and generate PDF/SVG tree visualizations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to analyze phylogenetic trees, detect orthologs/paralogs, or visualize tree structures.

say_en.text: Draw a phylogenetic tree from this Newick file and output PDF.
say_en.note: Claude will read the file and generate a tree figure.

say_en.text: Analyze duplication and speciation events in this gene tree.
say_en.note: Claude will detect evolutionary events and output results.

say_en.text: Compare topological differences between these two trees and compute RF distance.
say_en.note: Claude will calculate and report the distance.
